title: CrowdSec
description: CrowdSec LAPI decisions, AppSec WAF, edge bouncers, detection pipeline and ban log.

panels.title: Active decisions
panels.description: All IPs/ranges the LAPI currently tells bouncers to block (community blocklist + local).

panels.title: Community blocklist (CAPI)
panels.description: CAPI decisions; normally ~15-17k and refreshed every ~2h. Alert CrowdSecCommunityBlocklistMissing fires below 1000 for 6h.

panels.title: Local decisions
panels.description: Bans produced by our own detections (cluster agent, AppSec, VPS agent).

panels.title: Manual / list decisions
panels.description: cscli-added decisions and third-party blocklists (origin cscli / lists).

panels.title: Local bans (range)

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="crowdsec/crowdsec-lapi"} |= "module=db" |= " by ip " | regexp `msg="\((?P<machine>[a-z0-9-]+?)(?:-[0-9a-f]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?(?:/[^)]*)?\) (?:alert : )?(?P<reason>\S+) by ip (?P<ip>\S+) \((?P<country>[A-Z]*)/(?P<asn>\d*)\)(?: : (?P<duration>\S+) (?P<decision>\S+) on)?` | reason=~"$scenario" | decision="ban" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.description: Ban decisions recorded by the LAPI over the dashboard range (from LAPI logs; follows the scenario filter).

panels.title: Alerts (range)

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="crowdsec/crowdsec-lapi"} |= "module=db" |= " by ip " | regexp `msg="\((?P<machine>[a-z0-9-]+?)(?:-[0-9a-f]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?(?:/[^)]*)?\) (?:alert : )?(?P<reason>\S+) by ip (?P<ip>\S+) \((?P<country>[A-Z]*)/(?P<asn>\d*)\)(?: : (?P<duration>\S+) (?P<decision>\S+) on)?` | reason=~"$scenario" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.description: Alerts received by the LAPI over the dashboard range from all machines (cluster agent, AppSec, VPS), with or without a ban.

panels.title: AppSec blocks (range)

targets.expr: (sum(max_over_time(cs_appsec_block_total[$__range]) unless cs_appsec_block_total offset $__range) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(cs_appsec_block_total[$__range]) and cs_appsec_block_total offset $__range) or vector(0))

panels.description: Requests the in-band WAF blocked over the dashboard range.

panels.title: AppSec requests (range)

targets.expr: (sum(max_over_time(cs_appsec_reqs_total[$__range]) unless cs_appsec_reqs_total offset $__range) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(cs_appsec_reqs_total[$__range]) and cs_appsec_reqs_total offset $__range) or vector(0))

panels.description: Requests inspected by AppSec (only the routes listed under waf.routes in the envoy-bouncer HelmRelease; internal IPs are exempt).

panels.title: Envoy ext_authz checks (range)
panels.description: Requests checked by the Envoy ext_authz bouncer (envoy-bouncer) over the range.

panels.title: Router bouncer last pull
panels.description: Seconds since the OpenWrt bouncer last fetched /v1/decisions/stream (30s resolution, looks back 1h).

panels.title: VPS bouncer last pull
panels.description: Seconds since the PoT VPS bouncer (vps@<pod ip>) last fetched /v1/decisions/stream (30s resolution, looks back 1h).

panels.title: Components up
panels.description: Scrape targets up in the crowdsec namespace (agent, LAPI, AppSec, envoy-bouncer).

panels.title: Local decisions by scenario
panels.description: Active non-community decisions, by the scenario that produced them.

panels.title: Community blocklist (CAPI) by category
panels.description: Community blocklist decisions by behaviour category.

panels.title: Alerts and bans over time

targets.expr: sum by (machine) (count_over_time({job="crowdsec/crowdsec-lapi"} |= "module=db" |= " by ip " | regexp `msg="\((?P<machine>[a-z0-9-]+?)(?:-[0-9a-f]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?(?:/[^)]*)?\) (?:alert : )?(?P<reason>\S+) by ip (?P<ip>\S+) \((?P<country>[A-Z]*)/(?P<asn>\d*)\)(?: : (?P<duration>\S+) (?P<decision>\S+) on)?` | reason=~"$scenario" [$__interval]))

sum(count_over_time({job="crowdsec/crowdsec-lapi"} |= "module=db" |= " by ip " | regexp `msg="\((?P<machine>[a-z0-9-]+?)(?:-[0-9a-f]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?(?:/[^)]*)?\) (?:alert : )?(?P<reason>\S+) by ip (?P<ip>\S+) \((?P<country>[A-Z]*)/(?P<asn>\d*)\)(?: : (?P<duration>\S+) (?P<decision>\S+) on)?` | reason=~"$scenario" | decision="ban" [$__interval]))

panels.description: Alerts the LAPI received per interval, by reporting machine, plus how many led to a ban.

panels.title: Top scenarios (range)

targets.expr: sum by (reason) (count_over_time({job="crowdsec/crowdsec-lapi"} |= "module=db" |= " by ip " | regexp `msg="\((?P<machine>[a-z0-9-]+?)(?:-[0-9a-f]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?(?:/[^)]*)?\) (?:alert : )?(?P<reason>\S+) by ip (?P<ip>\S+) \((?P<country>[A-Z]*)/(?P<asn>\d*)\)(?: : (?P<duration>\S+) (?P<decision>\S+) on)?` | reason=~"$scenario" [$__range]))

sum by (reason) (count_over_time({job="crowdsec/crowdsec-lapi"} |= "module=db" |= " by ip " | regexp `msg="\((?P<machine>[a-z0-9-]+?)(?:-[0-9a-f]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?(?:/[^)]*)?\) (?:alert : )?(?P<reason>\S+) by ip (?P<ip>\S+) \((?P<country>[A-Z]*)/(?P<asn>\d*)\)(?: : (?P<duration>\S+) (?P<decision>\S+) on)?` | reason=~"$scenario" | decision="ban" [$__range]))

panels.description: Alerts and bans per scenario over the dashboard range (LAPI logs, all machines).

panels.title: Alerts by source country (range)

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (country) (count_over_time({job="crowdsec/crowdsec-lapi"} |= "module=db" |= " by ip " | regexp `msg="\((?P<machine>[a-z0-9-]+?)(?:-[0-9a-f]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?(?:/[^)]*)?\) (?:alert : )?(?P<reason>\S+) by ip (?P<ip>\S+) \((?P<country>[A-Z]*)/(?P<asn>\d*)\)(?: : (?P<duration>\S+) (?P<decision>\S+) on)?` | reason=~"$scenario" | country!="" [$__range])))

panels.description: Alerting source IPs' GeoIP country (from LAPI logs).

panels.title: Alerts by source AS (range)

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (asn) (count_over_time({job="crowdsec/crowdsec-lapi"} |= "module=db" |= " by ip " | regexp `msg="\((?P<machine>[a-z0-9-]+?)(?:-[0-9a-f]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?(?:/[^)]*)?\) (?:alert : )?(?P<reason>\S+) by ip (?P<ip>\S+) \((?P<country>[A-Z]*)/(?P<asn>\d*)\)(?: : (?P<duration>\S+) (?P<decision>\S+) on)?` | reason=~"$scenario" | asn!="" | asn!="0" [$__range])))

panels.description: Alerting source IPs' autonomous system number (from LAPI logs).

panels.title: Envoy ext_authz checks
panels.description: envoy-bouncer: every request on protected routes passes ext_authz; only hosts in waf.routes and non-internal IPs are forwarded to AppSec (WAF).

panels.title: AppSec requests vs blocks
panels.description: Requests inspected / blocked per AppSec listener (7422 = generic+vpatch+CRS out-of-band, 7423 = vpatch only). Counters appear on first use, so a single first hit may not show here.

panels.title: AppSec processing time (p95)
panels.description: Time AppSec spends evaluating a request (in-band adds latency to the request).

panels.title: AppSec rule hits
panels.description: Rule matches per interval. In-band matches block; out-of-band (CRS) matches only score.

panels.title: Top AppSec rules (range)

targets.expr: (sum by (rule_name, type) (max_over_time(cs_appsec_rule_hits[$__range]) unless cs_appsec_rule_hits offset $__range) or sum by (rule_name, type) (increase(cs_appsec_rule_hits[$__range]) and cs_appsec_rule_hits offset $__range))

panels.description: Rule matches over the dashboard range.

panels.title: Decision pulls per bouncer (per minute)
panels.description: GET /v1/decisions/stream per minute (firewall bouncers poll every ~10s, so ~6/min). A flat zero means that device's nftables sets are frozen (alert CrowdSecBouncerNotPulling).

panels.title: Machine heartbeat age
panels.description: Seconds since each registered agent (cluster agent, AppSec, LAPI's local agent, PoT VPS agent) last heartbeated to the LAPI.

panels.title: Log lines read per source
panels.description: Lines the agent pulls from Loki: envoy-gateway = public Envoy access logs, kernel = OpenWrt kernel log (cs-dnat + WAN rejects).

panels.title: Parser results
panels.description: Lines that made it through the parsers vs lines no parser accepted (e.g. Envoy's non-JSON startup lines).

panels.title: Whitelisted events
panels.description: Events dropped by whitelists (private ranges, tailnet/home WAN/GitHub hooks, CDNs).

panels.title: Bucket pours by scenario
panels.description: Events poured into scenario buckets.

panels.title: Bucket overflows by scenario
panels.description: Scenario overflows on the cluster agent (each becomes an alert; the VPS agent's are not in Prometheus).

panels.title: Live buckets by scenario
panels.description: Leaky buckets currently tracking a source.

panels.title: LAPI requests by route
panels.description: LAPI API calls from bouncers and agents.

panels.title: LAPI latency p95 by route
panels.description: 95th percentile LAPI response time.

panels.title: Alerts & bans (LAPI)

targets.expr: {job="crowdsec/crowdsec-lapi"} |= "module=db" |= " by ip " | regexp `msg="\((?P<machine>[a-z0-9-]+?)(?:-[0-9a-f]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?(?:/[^)]*)?\) (?:alert : )?(?P<reason>\S+) by ip (?P<ip>\S+) \((?P<country>[A-Z]*)/(?P<asn>\d*)\)(?: : (?P<duration>\S+) (?P<decision>\S+) on)?` | reason=~"$scenario" | line_format "{{.machine}}  {{.reason}}  {{.ip}} ({{.country}}/AS{{.asn}}){{if .decision}}  ->  {{.duration}} {{.decision}}{{end}}" |~ "(?i)$search"

panels.description: Every alert the LAPI stored (cluster agent, AppSec, PoT VPS) and the decision it produced. Use the search box for an IP, country or scenario.

panels.title: AppSec (WAF) alerts

targets.expr: {job="crowdsec/crowdsec-lapi"} |= "module=db" |= " by ip " |= "(crowdsec-appsec" | regexp `msg="\((?P<machine>[a-z0-9-]+?)(?:-[0-9a-f]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?(?:/[^)]*)?\) (?:alert : )?(?P<reason>\S+) by ip (?P<ip>\S+) \((?P<country>[A-Z]*)/(?P<asn>\d*)\)(?: : (?P<duration>\S+) (?P<decision>\S+) on)?` | line_format "{{.reason}}  {{.ip}} ({{.country}}/AS{{.asn}}){{if .decision}}  ->  {{.duration}} {{.decision}}{{end}}" |~ "(?i)$search"

panels.description: Alerts raised by the AppSec component (in-band vpatch blocks). AppSec does not log individual requests.

panels.title: Warnings & errors
panels.description: Warnings/errors from the agent, LAPI (incl. Telegram notification plugin), AppSec and envoy-bouncer. AppSec's startup 'conflicting id' noise is hidden.
